Thanks Ava — quick responses inline.

1) Signatory & routing: Mina (Head of Legal) can execute the DPA on Redwood's behalf for standard agreements. For anything that expands liability or changes processor/subprocessor obligations materially, our Executive Sponsor must countersign. For this redline set my expectation is Mina can sign.

2) E-sign provider: DocuSign is preferred on our side (audit trail + SAML integration). If CompactCloud prefers to originate the envelope, please set signer order so Redwood sees the fully executed copy (final) and include a DocuSign envelope link and envelope ID in the completed email. If we should originate, we will send from legal@redwood.ai with a signer order we can confirm.

3) Subprocessors & transfers: please attach your latest subprocessor list (we have a live registry but will need to reconcile). On SCCs — Redwood typically signs the EU SCC addendum; if CompactCloud has bespoke transfer language, please flag which clauses you need.

Action items from our side:
- Mina will confirm sign authority formally (I cc'd her).
- Priyom (contracts) will prepare the DocuSign template if Redwood is originating; Priyom, can you confirm the envelope template and default recipient fields?

If you want us to start the envelope we can do so within 2 hours; otherwise please send the envelope with the planned signer order.

Best,
